Pricing for small teams

The team plan costs 12 euros per person per month, billed monthly or yearly. It includes the weekly planner, unlimited projects and a shared calendar.

Questions about pricing

Can I cancel at any time?

Yes. Cancel from the billing page and your plan stays active until the end of the period.

Do you offer a free trial?

Yes. Every plan starts with a 14-day trial, no card required.

New to weekly planning? Start with the guide to planning a week, then meet the team behind Example.
